correctness.rationale: Derive gamma=(u^T X^dagger u)^-1 by rank-one Schur-complement/PSD criterion; diagonalize X=diag(a,b). For C=1/a,D=1/b, I=E[(Ccos²+Dsin²)^-1]=1/sqrt(CD); U+V=I and CU+DV=1 yield U=a sqrt(b)/(sqrt a+sqrt b), V=b sqrt(a)/(sqrt a+sqrt b), continuous at a=b. Then E[gamma uu^T]=sqrt(ab)/(sqrt a+sqrt b) sqrt(X), and min generalized eigenvalue of (E[gamma uu^T],X) equals sqrt(a)/(sqrt a+sqrt b); Q projected on b eigendirection attains it. Independent deterministic quadratures for (1,1),(1,4),(1,100),(0.1,7),(3,19) corroborate; integral is analytic for all a,b>0.
